accepted.feature: Terme del Nuotatore (Baths of the Swimmer)
accepted.quote: These baths were built in the late first century CE during the reign of Domitian. The complex was rebuilt during the Antonine period. The complex remained in use until ca. 250.
accepted.note: Built under Domitian in the late first century CE and rebuilt in the Antonine period; the end of use around 250 is approximate.
